items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: My piano was directly from Harry Rhodes’ factory.

ctx.x: The LP is a little incorrect. But I think I know what you’re saying because as I listen to Cannonball over the years when it got to that point it sounded to me like they were trying to join in to the fusion thing. And I always wondered was that a conscious decision? Did Cannon and Nat like sit down and have coffee and say this is where we’ve got to go if we want to keep making records, or was that not the case?

I couldn’t say anything. I don’t think I have an opinion about that. Because they were the first ones to use the Fender Rhodes. My piano was directly from Harry Rhodes’ factory. I think the move to the Fender Rhodes was the key to getting into the more fusion kind of thing. Yeah.
You weren’t that fond of it, is that correct?
